source_refs.note: Topic 5.6.1, printed pages 104-105, with Quick Check 5.5 (b to e) as the self-check. The print's hexane formula 'C6H6' is C6H14.

items: Temperature: a rise in temperature increases the average kinetic energy of the molecules, which lets them overcome the attractive forces, so viscosity falls.
Intermolecular forces: the stronger the intermolecular forces, the greater the viscosity, because the molecules cannot move around each other freely and the resistance to flow increases.
